note: Node Read Time shows an estimated reading time on nodes. All behaviour is driven by the config object node_read_time.settings, nested under a 'reading_time' mapping: container.<node_type>.is_activated (integer 1/0), words_per_minute (int, defaults to 225 when empty), unit_of_time (default|minute|second|below). Settings form at /admin/config/reading-time (route system.admin_config_reading_time). Activated types get an extra field 'reading_time' (place it on Manage display); there is also a computed base field node_read_time and a Views field 'Node read time'. No permissions, no Drush, no plugin type. Shipped baseline: container {}, words_per_minute 225, unit_of_time minute. medium/hard cases read/write node_read_time.settings; cleanup restores the baseline.

evals.prompt: Using the node_read_time Drupal module, where do I configure which content types show a reading time, and how do I actually get the reading time to appear on a node?
evals.expected_output: Configure it at /admin/config/reading-time (route system.admin_config_reading_time): tick the content types to activate. Then place the 'reading_time' extra field on that type's Manage display (it is hidden by default), or render {{ content.reading_time }} in a template.

evals.prompt: In the node_read_time module, which config key sets the reading speed used to calculate reading time, and what value is used if it is not set?
evals.expected_output: reading_time.words_per_minute in node_read_time.settings sets the rate; when empty the calculation falls back to 225 words per minute.

evals.prompt: What output formats can the node_read_time module use for the reading time (e.g. just minutes vs minutes and seconds), and which config key selects it?
evals.expected_output: reading_time.unit_of_time selects the format: 'minute' (whole minutes), 'second' (minutes + seconds), 'below' (minutes+seconds but '1 minute' when under a minute), or 'default' (bare rounded minute number).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the node_read_time module's reading speed has been changed from the default. Inspect the live node_read_time.settings configuration and state the current words-per-minute value.
evals.expected_output: reading_time.words_per_minute is 300. Read it with `drush config:get node_read_time.settings reading_time`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, how is the node_read_time reading time currently formatted (whole minutes, minutes and seconds, etc.)? Inspect the live configuration to answer.
evals.expected_output: reading_time.unit_of_time is 'second', i.e. minutes and seconds (e.g. '2 minutes, 30 seconds'). Read it from node_read_time.settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the node_read_time module to enable reading time for the Article content type. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set node_read_time.settings reading_time.container.article.is_activated to 1 (e.g. via the settings form at /admin/config/reading-time or config:set).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the node_read_time module to use a reading speed of 150 words per minute. Apply the change to the live site.
